en.title: House of the Dragon Star James Norton Reveals Audacious Bathtub Scene Choice
en.summary: James Norton, the actor behind Ormund Hightower, shares the surprising creative decision behind his character's unforgettable bathtub scene in Episode 4. His bold choice led to one of the season's most talked-about moments.
en.body:
In the tumultuous world of **House of the Dragon**, Episode 4 delivered a standout moment courtesy of **James Norton**'s portrayal of **Ormund Hightower**. The scene in question? A rather audacious bathtub sequence that has quickly become a talking point among viewers. Norton himself has revealed the thought process behind this memorable, and frankly, quite bold, scene.

Norton, who has been lauded for his villainous turn, discussed the pivotal bathtub scene with TVLine, marveling at the creative freedom he was afforded. The scene sees Ormund Hightower in a rather compromising position, yet using it to assert dominance and deliver a chilling lecture. Norton confessed his initial inclination to go big with his performance, a choice that the showrunners ultimately embraced. "I went so big — and they used it!" Norton shared, highlighting the collaborative spirit that allowed for such a striking visual and thematic statement. This moment, placed strategically in the episode, serves to solidify Ormund's character as a calculating and unrepentant figure, even in his most vulnerable state.

## Ormund's Audacious Performance

The scene, which occurs about a third of the way into the episode, features Ormund rising from a bathtub he had ostentatiously placed in the middle of a conquered great hall. Dripping and entirely naked, he proceeds to lecture the former lord and lady of the house on how to manage those "beneath you." This visual perfectly encapsulates the show's exploration of power, entitlement, and the stark contrast between the ruling families and the common folk. Norton's willingness to commit to such a scene, coupled with the directorial decision to keep it, underscores the show's commitment to pushing boundaries and delivering impactful character moments that linger long after the credits roll. It's a masterclass in using unexpected settings to amplify a character's ruthlessness.

## Fan Reaction and Narrative Impact

Fans on social media and forums have widely praised Norton's performance, with many calling him the MVP villain of the season so far. The bathtub scene, in particular, has been dissected for its sheer audacity and its effectiveness in defining Ormund's character. Viewers appreciate how the show isn't afraid to present its antagonists with such unflinching, often uncomfortable, depth. This memorable sequence, born from an actor's bold choice and a showrunner's willingness to trust that vision, has cemented Ormund Hightower as a truly formidable and unforgettable presence in the ongoing saga.

## What's Next

With **House of the Dragon** Season 3 reaching its halfway point, the stakes are clearly escalating. Fans can anticipate further revelations about **Ormund Hightower**'s grand plans for the Seven Kingdoms and the continued fallout from his ruthless campaigns. The show's ability to deliver such compelling character moments suggests that the latter half of the season will be packed with even more dramatic confrontations and pivotal decisions.
